_comment: EPISODE 4. The user compared all three earlier episodes and picked EPISODE 2 as the bar: its grading, its cast and its NATURALNESS. Episode 3 had every measurable defect fixed and lost the naturalness -- removing the handling made people hold the can at arm's length like a product shot. So this episode keeps every fix and brings the handling back as its own beat: the interviewer passes the can and the person takes it, hard cut, then the person glances down and back up with the can still upright, base down, label square to the lens. Eyes and head, not hands. The fused 'takes it and looks at it' is the one stage direction that caused four defects on seed 4827 and it is not back. NEW: one_mic. Watching episode 2 the user found a subject holding a SECOND handheld microphone at 7.5s and a dark object at a chest at 21s, and no clause this format has ever carried said how many microphones exist. Carried forward unchanged: the microphone, street and upright can all come from a face-cropped scene reference rather than from words (SKILL.md 27, 30); can_size for the tallboy scale; can_sealed OFF because two takes proved it does not render and the lid simply stays out of shot instead; the question asked once, in take A only; and the shot-aligned re-cut with the 0.40s minimum shot. ep1, ep2, ep3, ep3b and ep3c all stay on disk.
title: What's in the can
_output_comment: The output name carries all three seeds ON PURPOSE. build_looks.py's look filenames do not carry a seed and a seed-4816 build silently overwrote seed 4815's shipped deliverable once. This name cannot collide with episode 1 (4817-4819), episode 2 (4820-4822), any street-ld-*.mp4, or any 4815/4816/4823-4828 file.
_grade_comment: Not stored, same as episode 2. The episode is graded ONCE on the concatenated cut and the black lift is solved against that file by fit_grade.py at build time. A grade constant measured on one take outlives the take it was measured on (SKILL.md 19), and grading three takes separately is three curves across two joins, which is a visible step.
_ambience_comment: Not stored either, and this one has bitten twice (SKILL.md 13 and 21a): the speech-free window belongs to a FILE. build_episode.py finds it on the finished concatenation and asserts it is speech-free before cutting a bed or an end-card room tone from it.
_drop_comment: AN EDITORIAL TRIM, and it is here rather than inside the planner because it removes BEATS, not dead air. Takes A and C each rendered only four shots and every one of them carries a line, so there was no dead air to drop and the episode came to 38.4s against a 28-32s target. The shot-aligned rule forbids trimming inside a shot, so the only lever left is to cut whole beats -- a person and their guess. Three go, chosen so the escalation still builds: take A gives two guesses, take B gives four, take C gives two and then the reveal. 'That's a lager.' and 'Cheap lager.' were the same guess twice, which is why one of them is among the three. build_episode records the cut lines in the sidecar and check I excludes exactly those and still fails on any other line being inaudible.
